name: N2OChemistry
description:
Simulates atmospheric nitrous oxide chemistry with a concentration-dependent
lifetime and a stratospheric transport delay, using Prather-style fixed-point
iterations.

# What This Component Does

1. Calculates the effective N2O atmospheric lifetime including:
   - Stratospheric photolysis/destruction (primary sink)
   - Concentration-dependent feedback (with default parameters, higher N2O → shorter lifetime)
   - Faster stratospheric overturning with warming (meridional flux feedback)

2. Solves the mass balance equation using 4 fixed-point iterations:
   $$\frac{dB}{dt} = E - \frac{\bar{B}_{delayed}}{\tau}$$

   where the sink term uses delayed concentrations to account for the
   stratospheric transport delay.

This follows the MAGICC7 `NITROUS` subroutine. Starting from the burden $B$ at the
start of the year, each iteration estimates the mid-year burden, evaluates
the lifetime from it and integrates the sink using the burden averaged over
the delayed years.

# Inputs

- `Prescribed Atmospheric Concentrations|N2O` (ppb), only with the `concentration_switch_year` parameter

# Feedback references

As in MAGICC7, the concentration feedback is measured from the year before
`feedback_start_year`, and warming changes the meridional flux relative to
`meridional_flux_reference_year`. References outside the run are clamped to
its first or last year.

# Differences from MAGICC7

- **Budget initialisation**: natural emissions are a fixed parameter.
  `rscm.magicc.full.natural_emissions` calculates MAGICC7's budget-closing value for it.

With `concentration_switch_year` the concentration follows
`Prescribed Atmospheric Concentrations|N2O` until that year.

inputs.name: Emissions|N2O
inputs.description: Anthropogenic N2O emissions over the step

inputs.name: Surface Air Temperature Change
inputs.description: Surface air temperature change that drives the meridional flux feedback

outputs.name: Lifetime|N2O
outputs.description: Effective N2O lifetime over the step

states.name: Atmospheric Concentrations|N2O
states.description: N2O concentration at the end of the step

parameters.name: feedback_start_year
parameters.description:
Year from which the concentration feedback is measured (MAGICC7 `N2O_FEED_YRSTART`).

unit: yr

The reference concentration is taken from the year before.

parameters.name: natural_emissions
parameters.description:
Natural N2O emissions from soils, oceans and other sources.

unit: Mt N2ON/yr

MAGICC7 closes the 1982-1991 budget against observed concentrations.
The default is the value it derives for its standard historical inputs.

parameters.name: initial_n2o_lifetime
parameters.description:
Base atmospheric lifetime before the concentration feedback, $\tau_{init}$

unit: yr

parameters.name: lifetime_feedback
parameters.description:
Lifetime feedback exponent, $S$.

unit: dimensionless

With $S < 0$, higher concentrations give a slightly shorter lifetime,
because $\tau = \tau_{init} \max(1, B/B_0)^S$.

parameters.name: stratospheric_delay
parameters.description:
Delay for tropospheric N2O to reach the stratosphere and be destroyed (MAGICC7 `N2O_STRATMIXDELAY`)

unit: yr

parameters.name: tg_per_ppb
parameters.description:
Conversion factor from ppb to Tg N (MAGICC7 `N2O_PPB2TGN`)

unit: Tg N/ppb

parameters.name: include_meridional_flux_feedback
parameters.description: Apply the stratospheric lifetime response to meridional flux changes (MAGICC7 `N2O_USE_TAUSTRAT_VAR`)

parameters.name: meridional_flux_change_per_degree
parameters.description:
Fractional change in meridional flux per degree of warming (MAGICC7 `GEN_MERIDFLUX_CHNGPERDEG`)

unit: K^-1

parameters.name: lifetime_sensitivity_to_meridional_flux
parameters.description:
Lifetime sensitivity to meridional flux changes (MAGICC7 `N2O_TAUSTRAT_SENS2MERIDFLUX`)

unit: dimensionless

parameters.name: meridional_flux_reference_year
parameters.description:
Year from which warming changes the meridional flux (MAGICC7 `GEN_CHANGE_MERIDIONALFLUX_YR`)

unit: yr

parameters.name: concentration_switch_year
parameters.description:
Last year of concentrations prescribed by `Prescribed Atmospheric Concentrations|N2O`
(MAGICC7 `N2O_SWITCHFROMCONC2EMIS_YEAR`).

unit: yr

`None` calculates concentrations from emissions throughout.
